abstracts.value: 본 연구는 디지털 원격대학 교육의 질을 높이기 위해 디지털 원격대학에 적합한 학사행정 및 조직모형을 탐색, 제안하고 있다. 문헌분석, 전문가의견분석, 국내벤치마킹, 국내외 원격대학 현황분석 결과를 종합적으로 적용하였으며, 연구결과는 국내 디지털 원격대학의 학사·조직 모형에 대한 심도 있는 연구의 필요성과 이들 대학의 설치인가 기준을 좀 더 폭넓고 의미있는 영역에서 도출할 필요성을 보여주었다. 성공적인 교육서비스를 만들고 운영하기 위해서 원격대학이 갖추어야 할 학사 및 조직모형이 학사행정, 교수 학습지원, 학생지원 및 복지, 교육평가시스템의 교수·행정지원 측면에서 구체적으로 제안되었다. 그러나 본 연구가 제안하는 모형은 관련 기관이 디지털 원격대학을 설립 혹은 개선하고자 할 때 참고가 될 '개념적인 틀일 뿐이며 적용하는 기관의 설립 철학과 다양한 변인들에 따라 무한히 다른 실제 모형이 가능함을 전제로 하고 있다.

Organized and practical efforts to improve the quality of education are called for immediately with the unparalleled expansion in its size and diversification in its services. A part of such efforts is research on academic administration and organization model that can accommodate diversities in distance education types, services, technologies, and students. The purpose of this study is to explore and propose an academic administration and organizational model appropriate for enhancing the educational quality of digital distance universities. It can be utilized as an alternative solution to the problems that digital distance universities in Korea and other countries have experienced with inappropriate academic administration and organizational structure and the future evaluation of digital distance universities.
This study employs a comprehensive cross analysis of a diverse set of information that enhances the quality of the research product as follows: (1) Literature Review; (2) Analysis of Web Sites; (3) Survey of expert opinions; (4) Benchmark analysis of domestic distance education enterprises; and (5) Current survey of digital distance universities
A proposal of academic administration and organizational model for digital distance universities is made based on the above literature review, survey of expert opinions, benchmark analysis of distance education enterprises, and analysis of academic administration and organization of international and domestic digital distance universities.
We propose an academic administration and organization model for successful educational service. This model shows that digital distance universities should be equipped with detailed services on both the faculty and staff sides of the academic administration, instruction-learning support, student aid, and educational evaluation, and that these services also need support in the form of organization. The model also emphasizes flexibility and dynamism that connects services and organizations and enables timely provision of services and top-level receptiveness.
